Recharge Ticket Creation Rate (System Health)
For every hour a customer had already paid for (excluding their first 30 days post-install), does a recharge ticket's [created_at, obligation_window_end) window span that hour? Connections currently DEACTIVATED or PENDING_DEACTIVATION are excluded. Measures ticket creation and system-tracked obligation coverage only, not partner claim speed or resolution time. Only D-1..D-3 are computed; W-1..M-3 are not available for this metric.
